Three years ago, the curtain fell on a crowded theater in Boston, and five people never made it home. Among the dead was journalist Vada Keene’s estranged father. The killer confessed. The case closed. The audience moved on.

But when Vada begins receiving cryptic letters from the imprisoned shooter she finds herself dragged back into the final moments of that night. Teaming up with detective Nolan Ryder, a cold case investigator with his own scars, Vada begins pulling at threads until everything around her begins to unravel. 

Now Vada and Ryder are racing toward a truth hidden behind grief, guilt, and secrets that survived long after the applause died away.

Because sometimes the most dangerous part of the story begins after the curtain closes.
